title: Complaints of Noise and Smell from Live Chickens in HDB and Private Residential Estates
what_it_is: Complaints of Noise and Smell from Live Chickens in HDB and Private Residential Estates

sections.label: Poultry rearing limits and HDB ban
sections.summary: Poultry rearing on any premises is generally limited to 10, but keeping poultry in HDB flats is not allowed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To mitigate the risk of avian disease and to safeguard human and animal health, we, generally, limit the number of poultry that can be reared on any premises on a non-commercial basis to 10.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: But for HDB flats, the rule is stricter and the keeping of poultry is not allowed for public health reasons and to manage disamenities.

sections.label: Feedback on chickens in estates
sections.summary: Over five years, 2,400 pieces of feedback concerned chickens in HDB estates and 1,700 in private residential estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Just to clarify the point in the Member's question, I said that over the last five years, as asked by the Member, a total of 2,400 pieces of feedback were about chickens in HDB estates and 1,700 pieces of feedback in the last five years were for private residential estates.

sections.label: HDB Memorandum of Lease
sections.summary: For HDB, the matter is more specific to HDB's Memorandum of Lease.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In terms of HDB, it is more specific to HDB's Memorandum of Lease.

sections.label: Community approach to chicken cases
sections.summary: Fines are not a first resort; parties are brought together, with no intent to target students hatching chickens, focusing on public health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: On Assoc Prof Lim's first supplementary question, indeed, we do not resort to fines and enforcement penalties as a first resort.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Often, if it is a community case, we do want to bring the different parties together, especially the advisors with the grassroots volunteers, the community leaders and the neighbours, to come together to talk about it and see how we can come to an accommodation, especially about chickens in private residential properties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: There is no intent to go after any students or anyone who hatch chickens at home.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: First and foremost, I would like to reiterate that from NParks' point of view, it is really about public health, safeguarding all of our health, especially when it comes to zoonotic diseases.

sections.label: Managing rooster crowing noise
sections.summary: Rooster crowing noise can be managed by relocating the rooster or covering the pen with a cloth in private estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For example, if it is about rooster crowing – some roosters crow even when the sun is not rising, thinking that the sun rises because of it – we can consider managing the noise by relocating the rooster or, in the case of private estate homes, to encourage owners to cover the pen with a cloth, so that the roosters do not crow or fight with one another.
